html:
ROCKET PROPELLED GHOST is an arcade shooter all about collecting spirits with your rocket-launching buddy Despenst! It's a tight, short game designed to be replayed to get better and better scores, and unlock more and more furnishings for your terrible apartment.

ALIVE OR DEAD

Launch yourself around the levels with powerful ghost rockets! But be careful, these rockets will instantly return you to the realm of the dead! Worry not, however. You can use your ghastly form to pass through certain walls and can resurrect with the click of a button.

DO IT FAST

While collecting spirits, they'll constantly trickle down! So not only do you want to plan and master a route to snag as many spirits as you can, make sure to do it as quickly as possible to max out that score!

GET SOME NICE FURNITURE

By collecting enough spirits per-level and overall, you can unlock new pieces of furniture to turn your crappy apartment into a slightly less crappy apartment!

ENJOY SOME EXCELLENT TUNES

RPG features a jazzy soundtrack composed by Landen Howell, the same musician who composed the score to Void Collector!
